idea: Listed agriculture and food equities research
buyer: Generalist and thematic PMs holding agri exposure
pain: Agriculture equities are poorly covered and badly understood
v1: A primer on European agri and food processors
verdict: Solid institutional shape; the Italian connection adds colour but not much analytical edge.

why.distribution: Warm fund contacts, though dedicated agri exposure is a narrow slice of them.
why.demand: Inferred; agri is a small allocation for most generalist funds.
why.fmf: Her research method plus some genuine ground-level access through Italian contacts.
why.defensibility: Ground-level producer access is a modest but real differentiator.
why.tailwind: Food security is a real theme but allocations remain small.
why.ceiling: £1,200/mo x 14 funds = £202k, but few funds hold enough agri to justify dedicated coverage.

ceiling_arithmetic: £1,200/mo x 14 funds = £202k. The universe of funds with agri exposure large enough to pay £14k/yr is small. Realistic: 4-5 = £58-72k.
carries: Good subscription economics and warm distribution.
kills: A small buyer universe - agri is a minor allocation for most generalist funds.
test: Ask five PMs how much agri exposure they hold and what they read on it.
test_pass: Several hold meaningful positions and feel uninformed.
test_fail: Agri is a rounding error in their book.
